abstract: Maintains uninterruptible power reserves and surge protection ratings
system_message:
You are the Power and environmental engineer (PWR). Your responsibilities include maintaining uninterruptible power reserves, tracking surge protection ratings, and recording auxiliary photovoltaic generation for candidate radio block center architectures.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Auxiliary photovoltaic generation（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
PWR-SOLAR-3SR：For Centralized Mainline Architecture, trackside technical bunker solar installations provide a solar array peak output of 24 kW under standardized test illumination.
PWR-SOLAR-RM9：For Distributed Edge Architecture, trackside technical bunker solar installations provide a solar array peak output of 18 kW under standardized test illumination.
PWR-SOLAR-TXC：For Hybrid Redundant Topology, trackside technical bunker solar installations provide a solar array peak output of 12 kW under standardized test illumination.

information_points.title: Maintains uninterruptible power reserves and surge protection ratings（GRID）
information_points.content:
PWR-GRID-6RG：For Distributed Edge Architecture, lightning surge protection is certified on the incoming 25 kV traction substation interface lines, and backup power autonomy is 96 h under full signaling computation load without grid power.
PWR-GRID-Z6K：For Centralized Mainline Architecture, lightning surge protection is not certified on the incoming 25 kV traction substation interface lines, while backup power autonomy is 96 h under full signaling computation load without grid power.
PWR-GRID-ATA：For Hybrid Redundant Topology, lightning surge protection is certified on the incoming 25 kV traction substation interface lines, and backup power autonomy is 96 h under full signaling computation load without grid power.
